_readme: Posting queue. Posts go out at their `at` time (UTC; 01:30Z = 07:00 IST, 13:30Z = 19:00 IST). A run posts the oldest due post that isn't on Instagram yet. Render with `npm run social:render`, commit and deploy before the time. Text in [[double brackets]] is highlighted. Never change the first caption line of a posted post: it's how duplicates are detected. Reels (`type: "reel"`) are finished MP4s at website/social/reels/<id>.mp4 instead of slides.
